lifecycle_controls.name: failed poll withholding
lifecycle_controls.description: A poll that fails at any exchange publishes no Reading for any selected channel, even channels whose value and quality were already read.
lifecycle_controls.scenario: native NAK on first quality read

lifecycle_controls.name: prior poll retention
lifecycle_controls.description: Poll N succeeds (scenario 'rio_mm1 single analog 15.5', labels 1..6) then poll N+1 on the same connection starts at label 7 and fails; poll N's rows remain recoverable and poll N+1 publishes nothing.

lifecycle_controls.name: original deadline
lifecycle_controls.description: One deadline set at poll start covers every exchange; a response that would complete after it fails the poll with a timeout. No retry, reconnect or extra request follows.

lifecycle_controls.name: exclusive cutoff
lifecycle_controls.description: A poll that completes at or after the acquisition cutoff is not published.

lifecycle_controls.name: no writes
lifecycle_controls.description: No exchange in any scenario uses tcode 0, 1 or 5; every request byte3 is 0x40.
